details: Bitcoin has extended its rally, trading above $80,000 and approaching the $82,000 resistance level. This upward movement is supported by significant net inflows into US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs), which recorded $159.5 million on September 17 and an additional $433 million on September 18. This signals a tentative return of institutional demand, with analysts eyeing further resistance targets at $84,000 to $85,000.
title: Bitcoin Surpasses $80K Amid Strong ETF Inflows

details: Ethereum's price has climbed above $2,600, reaching its highest level since January, following a period of decline from over $4,500. This rally is accompanied by increased activity from large holders ("whales") and a record 207.17 million non-empty Ethereum wallets. Additionally, exchange reserves have dropped to their lowest point in 2026, indicating reduced selling pressure despite recent outflows from US spot Ethereum ETFs.
title: Ethereum Reaches Multi-Month High as Whale Activity Surges

details: While the US Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act, leading to some market uncertainty, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has submitted new rule proposals concerning crypto asset transactions and markets to the White House for review. This development signals that regulatory progress for digital assets continues, even without new specific legislation, which is viewed positively by the market as a step towards clearer frameworks.
title: US Crypto Regulation Advances Despite CLARITY Act Setback

details: The Federal Reserve implemented its first interest rate hike in three years, raising the target range by 25 basis points. Despite initial market jitters, Bitcoin quickly recovered and held its ground above $81,000, demonstrating resilience. However, the Fed's hawkish stance, which removed expectations for monetary easing through 2027, and persistent inflation pressures from high oil prices, present potential headwinds for market liquidity moving forward.
title: Crypto Market Shows Resilience After Fed Rate Hike

details: XRP saw stabilization after a partial recovery, trading around $1.33. This follows a sharp decline earlier in the week when the proposed US crypto market-structure legislation, the CLARITY Act, failed to pass the Senate. Despite the immediate market uncertainty, Ripple stated that the outcome does not alter XRP's existing legal classification, leading investors to weigh short-term sentiment against its long-term payments use case.
title: XRP Stabilizes Post-CLARITY Act Failure

details: An MEV (Maximal Extractable Value) bot named "Yoink" successfully out-raced a hacker on September 15, 2026, to secure 2,900 rsETH tokens worth approximately $7.8 million. The hacker had attempted to exploit a Safe smart-contract wallet on Ethereum, but the bot paid a higher fee to front-run the transaction and claim the funds, leaving the original attacker with nothing.
title: MEV Bot "Yoink" Intercepts $7.8M from rsETH Exploit
